pattern: ARIA status live region (role="status", implicit aria-live="polite").
focus: Not focusable. Focus is never moved.
notes: The status region is rendered empty until the delay elapses; inserting the label then triggers a polite announcement.
Rotation stops under prefers-reduced-motion or animation: none; the static icon and the label remain.
The label is visually hidden by default and always remains in the accessibility tree.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
